definition: means management for an illness or injury which results in symptoms which occur suddenly and unexpectedly, and requires immediate care by a medical practitioner to prevent death or serious long term impairment of the insured person's health.
plain: Treatment for something that came on suddenly and needs immediate attention to prevent death or lasting harm.
whyItMatters: This is the test that decides whether the network rules bend. In a genuine emergency you go to the nearest capable hospital, in or out of network, and intimate the insurer afterwards rather than before. Insurers do assess whether an admission was truly emergent, so the medical record needs to show the urgency, not just the diagnosis.
